heard: A Soviet lander touched Mars and died in seconds. It made history as the first successful soft landing. Then the probe transmitted data for only 14 seconds. It returned only a partial gray image with no details. A massive planet-wide dust storm raged below. Nobody knew what happened to the lost hardware. Decades later, citizen scientists searched NASA photos. They found the parachute sitting on the surface. Amateur sleuths spotted a Soviet lander on Mars.
